Gold Nugget — Config-injection pattern for testable helpers: effectiveMaxDepth (WP-003) uses an optional configMax parameter (default: getMaxHandoffDepth()) that allows test code to inject a fixed value without mocking the config singleton. This pattern should become the standard template for any new helper that reads from getConfig() or getMaxHandoffDepth(). Applying it retroactively to hasDependencyBlocked/isBlockedByDependencies is not needed (they read no config), but any future helpers that read config state should follow this pattern to keep tests fast and hermetic.

Technical debt surfaced (WP-004): The describe block 'auto_handoff_depth reset algorithm' in tests/tools/work-package.test.ts (line 158) is dead test code testing removed behavior via a local helper. This should be cleaned up in the next technical debt session to prevent future developer confusion about the actual reset contract (\u00a718.4: reset in completeSynthesis only).
